headline: Voltas Appoints D’Souza as Chair as Leadership Reshuffle Continues
summary: Voltas appointed D’Souza as its new chairman, placing a key board position under an executive hired by Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran.
why: Voltas is a prominent Tata Group company, and executive appointments reflect ongoing leadership realignments within the conglomerate.

impacts.name: Voltas
impacts.why: Board leadership changes influence corporate governance and strategic execution.
